sentences.text: The ACT Integrity Commission assessed a corruption complaint referred after parliamentary scrutiny of the sale of a Dickson car park to the Tradies Club.
sentences.support: The Committee’s referral was accepted by the Commission as a corruption complaint

sentences.text: It examined the sale process and the government’s linked purchase of land at Downer.
sentences.support: examined the facts surrounding the sale of Block 30 and the purchase of the Downer site

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that the sale met legal requirements and raised no reasonable suspicion of corruption, although some decisions needed better documentation.
sentences.support: the Commission found that the land sale process itself was adequate and complied with all necessary legal requirements

sentences.text: It discontinued the matter because it considered further action on the corruption report unjustified.
sentences.support: further dealing with the corruption report is not justified

notes: The executive summary expressly says it is not to be read as part of the report. Findings and disposition were also checked against the conclusion. Existing OPAX findings mean no additional findings quotes. No recommendations list identified.
